name: Wi-Fi Diagnostics
description: Structured read-only wireless information, active survey, and station snapshots.

actions.unavailable_reason: Both physical radios carry active management/client networking, and no action-owned atomic netifd/GL.iNet transaction with proven management recovery exists yet.

help_text: Survey selects a current wireless interface and runs exact iwinfo info/scan or iw station dump without reconfiguration. Monitor-mode creation remains unavailable because both physical radios carry active management/client traffic and the installed workflow has no reliable atomic rollback across GL.iNet netifd state.
